title: A complete PyTorch training loop with early stopping
hints: One epoch: model.train(); perm = torch.randperm(N); for each slice of perm of size batch_size: optimizer.zero_grad(); loss = loss_fn(model(X[idx]), y[idx]); loss.backward(); optimizer.step(). Accumulate loss.item() * len(idx) and divide by N at the end.

evaluate: model.eval() and with torch.no_grad(): one forward pass over the whole set; return loss.item() and (logits.argmax(1) == y).float().mean().item(). The tests check both the mode flag and that grad is disabled inside the forward.

Early stopping: keep best_loss, best_epoch and a copy of the best state_dict ({k: v.clone() ...}). After each epoch, if val_loss < best_loss reset the counter, else increment it and stop when it reaches patience. Before returning, model.load_state_dict(best_state).
